task: Diagnose #576 (kubelet probes to storage/seaweedfs-volume-0 and openbao-agent-injector rejected by ztunnel istio_converted_static_strict after node restarts) and ship the smallest durable fix: istio-cni enableAmbientDetectionRetry plus a verify-cluster detection and runbook. No live cluster mutation.

events.summary: One GitOps value (cni.ambient.enableAmbientDetectionRetry) mirrored in the 09-istio-ambient.sh bootstrap values, a verify-cluster podhealth detection, R307, lessons-log row and troubleshooting 10.1. Deliberately left alone: the live cluster (no helm/Gitea push, no node reboot), Cilium CCNP allow-ambient-kubelet-probes, istioOwnedCNIConfig, dataplane-mode none opt-outs, the broad grep -v openbao in verify-cluster (reported only).

Not reproduced (needs a node reboot). Reconstructed from retained logs: worker-1 reboot 12:20Z; cilium-cni released RunPodSandbox 12:21:31Z; seaweedfs-volume-0 sandbox returned 12:21:43.3Z; istio-cni agent socket opened 12:21:44.08Z with 'pod seaweedfs-volume-0 does not appear to have any assigned IPs, not syncing with ipset'; pod never got 'adding pod to the mesh' that boot; its outbound was meshed (HBONE identity) while ztunnel rejected probes with src=node CiliumInternalIP 10.244.4.38 (219 denials to dst 10.244.4.230). Istio 1.30.1 plugin.go swallows isAmbientPod errors when ENABLE_AMBIENT_DETECTION_RETRY=false and informers.go reconcilePod is a no-op for an already-enrolled pod. The plugin's own error line is not retained, so that step is inferred.

Set cni.ambient.enableAmbientDetectionRetry: true (helm template of cni 1.30.1 renders ENABLE_AMBIENT_DETECTION_RETRY: "true"). Added ambient_probe_denials() and a podhealth scan in verify-cluster.sh, runbook and lessons-log row.
